Create Patient.description: Registers an HIV client as a FHIR Patient in the Ethiopia NDR.

Create Encounter.description: Records a clinic visit (e.g. an ART follow-up) for a patient.

Create Viral Load Observation.description: Records an HIV viral load lab result as an Observation.

Create CD4 Count Observation.description: Records a CD4 count lab result as an Observation.

Create HIV Diagnosis Condition.description: Records a confirmed HIV diagnosis as a Condition.

Create Facility Organization.description: Registers a health facility as a FHIR Organization.

Create Practitioner.description: Registers a clinician as a FHIR Practitioner.
